name: Realm: storm plains (realistic)
description: Setting: a grounded, cinematic storm plain photographed on location like a feature-film still - wide flat farmland and low hills under towering thunderheads, stone watchtowers and wet roads, dramatic hard light breaking through rain, cool slate and gold tones; any magic is a faint charge in the air; nothing from the modern world
notes: The lightning homeland as a place: use it with the backgrounds in backgrounds/fantasy/country/lightning/ (set components.realm).
